contexts.text: Arise, walk through the Land = that he should survey the heavenly Kingdom.
The men rose up = that this perception was finished.
(Lot) rose up to meet them = acknowledgement, and also being affected with charity.
In the morning rise up and go ye on your way = thus confirmation in good and truth.

Arise, go ye out from this place = that they should not remain in a state of evil... To arise is often read in the Word... In the inward sense, it involves elevation. AC 2785. AC 2857. AC 2912. AC 2927. AC 3050. AC 3188. AC 3334. AC 3458. AC 3552. AC 3663. AC 4092. AC 4103. AC 4115. AC 4539. AC 4881. AC 7435. AC 9028.
To rise up early = to perceive clearly.
Arise = elevation of the mind. AC 7717.
Since the Natural is here treated of, and this is represented by Jacob, it is not said that he arose... but that he lifted up his feet...
I cannot rise up before thee (said by Rachel, when she was sitting on the teraphim) = that they cannot be revealed.
My sheaf arose and stood up = the doctrinal concerning the Lord's Divine Human... To arise and stand up = what is supreme that will reign, and that will be adored.
To arise = elevation to higher, or more interior things, thus to those which are of the spiritual life. References. AC 5627. AC 5637. AC 9387.
Jacob arose = the elucidation of natural truth.
To arise, when said of those who are in externals without an internal, does not signify elevation, but excitation.
To arise and bow themselves = to adore holily.
Arise, and measure the temple of God = to see and know.
Thou knowest my sitting and mine uprising. To know his sitting, has regard to the esse of his life, which is the will; the uprising, to the intention thence.
